retainedGuards.claim: X7e creates the submit action using Jx and onClick closure ()=>void B(), where B is handleSubmit. Disabled/interactions, voice state and submitButtonMode guard the action. granularityRationale: 通用应用操作历史不同于某次归档的专用撤销入口，也不同于路由或浏览器历史；undo和redo保留为两个操作。

chain: undoAppAction defaults to Hoe(scope), is enabled by bde, and supplies a separate keyboardHandler through oMi/i5n. redoAppAction defaults to Ore(scope), is enabled by yLe, and supplies oMi/a5n. No command-local priority or isActive option is supplied for these two registrations.

For a nonstandard undo/redo key oMi directly invokes the app-action fallback. For a standard key it first tries the supplied edit-history callback: exact true handles it; otherwise a focused other element, or composer with null result, returns false; all remaining cases invoke the app-action fallback.

Standard undo matching uses CmdOrCtrl+Z. Standard redo uses Command+Shift+Z under Qh(), otherwise Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z; these source key matches are separate from arbitrary configured shortcut bindings.

Composer edit history searches connected RP elements containing the active HTMLElement. Undo with hasText()===false returns false; otherwise the requested editHistory method result or null is returned. A non-HTMLElement or unmatched active element returns null.
The explicit I1t export used as initial.Hoe calls zLt(scope,undo). The command is an app-action history adapter, not browser or router back navigation.
The explicit F1t export used as initial.Ore calls zLt(scope,redo). Its return describes accepted history work rather than completion of the queued effect.
The M1t export used as bde derives undo availability solely from eI.length>0 in this selected definition. Effective mounting and winning command registration remain outside this source fact.
The j1t export used as yLe derives redo availability from tI.length>0. This is not evidence that a remote action, navigation or persistence result has succeeded.
zLt selects the last ID from the chosen undo/redo list, returns false if absent, then looks up the entry in the scope-selected registry and delegates BLt when present.

BLt rejects a side mismatch, a redo entry absent from tI, an expired committed entry, or a required navigation that cannot be prepared. Accepted work removes the entry from its visible side, assigns a request order, queues on transitionQueueKey, and returns true before waiting for completion.

The queued transition awaits the original completion Promise. Timed-out work calls the corresponding error callback; noncommitted or replaced entries do not run the effect. It awaits prepared navigation then undo/redo, catches effect errors for the corresponding callback, rechecks registry identity, moves the side and restores expiry. Undo alone adds the success toast; stale request order controls rearming/final cleanup.

The history registry is a WeakMap selected by qLt identity and contains entries, request ordering, redo invalidation order and transition tails. This source-scoped object is not proof of physical storage, cross-window identity or restart recovery.

FLt creates a Symbol ID and pending entry with current location, appends it to undo history and installs the YLt pending timeout. Its returned handle exposes commit/discard/invalidate/undo/redo and dismiss handling. commit arms expiry only while the selected side remains present.

QF settles a pending entry, cancels its pending timer, advances redo invalidation on committed/timed-out outcomes, recomputes redo visibility and resolves completion. Discard and timeout are distinct completion outcomes.

Redo visibility excludes entries invalidated through the recorded request order and entries older than pending-action ordering. Invalidated redo entries are finalized and removed; visible redo IDs are sorted by request order.

GLt clears the prior expiry timer and uses dynamic expiration time when supplied, otherwise expiresAfterMs. Zero expiry finalizes immediately; otherwise a timeout delegates ZF. Neither this timer nor YLt establishes persistence.

chain: Ke merges existing roots, task/git-origin inferred roots and manually added roots using imported R-derived deduplication keys; lt ignores remote task records. Labels use trimmed saved label or imported fallback dt. These are candidate computations, not a live project list or proof of the imported normalizer semantics.

Add project is a local menu with Start from scratch and Use an existing folder. Remote host uses the folder callback directly. Start from scratch runs on menu close autofocus only when selected. Folder callback dispatches electron-pick-workspace-root-option with allowMultiple:false.

The exact main case awaits projectFolderPicker.pickProjectSources. Non-local hosts emit remote-workspace-root-requested. Local picker permits openDirectory/createDirectory, optional multiselect/hidden files; cancel returns no roots. Selected paths are normalized/stat-checked directories; stat failures are logged and filtered. Each retained root emits workspace-root-option-picked.

workspace-root-option-picked adds and checks the root locally. Single toggle adds the root to manual candidates and writes M[root]; select-all writes each candidate V entry. This does not call project registration. Local rows use paths-exist and hide missing paths; remote rows skip that check. V is computed before row filtering, so do not equate V with mounted rows.

Continue UI is disabled for no selected roots, loading, or any pendingAction. Callback clears error and uses the pendingAction guard. Shared async q uses a separate Re.current latch, merges existing roots only when override is workspace, and calls Me().createOrSelectLocalProjects. Imported Mln resolves exactly to mI, which throws when Pd.projects is absent.

Only the returned project-operation Promise installs finally resetting Re.current. Empty returned array stops completion; rejected Promise resets the latch then reaches manual inline error or automatic toast. A synchronous factory/method failure before Promise.finally can leave Re.current true; the caller still clears pendingAction. No cancellation or latch timeout is declared here.

Nonempty registration records onboarding time, resets override to auto, increments focus nonce, and navigates replace only if captured/current location key matches or the precise root-location fallback passes. Automatic continuation fires at most once when no existing/inferred roots, not loading, and selected roots exist; its Fe latch is set before the call and not reset on failure.

chain: Ac renders jc around Mc and supplied children. jc permits local-thread/client-local-thread, otherwise home navigation; Suspense has a named loading fallback. A route host different from selected host takes precedence and shows host loading before archived hydration. chatgpt.conversations capability controls a supplied handoff callback, not the general page rendering guard.

Mc effective archived-preview is route flag AND (selected archived atom OR imported Si); this is narrower than the raw flag used by jc to select fs. It suppresses site preview and selected normal-thread integrations, then passes the effective flag to lc. Do not collapse these two predicates.

Nc first rejects unsupported route kinds, then shows removed-host connection-unavailable when selected status is unavailable. It remembers id when a!=null AND c AND !l; c/l are named selected atom values, not evaluated here. For archived conversation outside effective preview, g!==id OR (c AND history status!==resumed) selects Ic; otherwise !c selects Fc. These conditions are not an unconditional archive redirect.

Ic queries !isConversationArchiving only when imported capability o is true; retry:false, stale/gc zero, no focus refetch. True result navigates to same location with archivedConversationPreview:true and replace; loading shows spinner. Otherwise Unarchive and open sets local pending and delegates selected manager unarchiveConversation(useAppServerPins). Rejection clears pending and shows danger; success callback does not itself navigate/reset pending.
Fc schedules replace navigation home with focusComposerNonce and an optional normalized project. The scheduling is source-only; project manager result and UI receipt are not proved.

fs archived hydration query is keyed by account/user/host/conversation/location key; staleTime Infinity, gcTime zero, retry false. Pending or fetching shows loading; only data===true renders children, all other settled values show Try again calling refetch. The query signal is not passed to hydrateArchivedThreadPreview; it gates error recovery. A matching persistent session, matching account key, nonaborted signal and qualified imported error predicate cause saved-preview clearing and same-location flag=false replacement; the original error is rethrown.

lc selects existing-conversation host or pending-client-thread host with local fallback. Effective archive preview passes shouldResume:false/isReadOnly:true, removes normal and overlay composer, uses local archive footer. Normal visibility/overlay conditions depend on explicit local panel flags; yj permits overlay only when chat pane is hidden and active tab lacks sidechat:, sidechat-loading:, background-agent: prefix. A mounted page alone does not prove content/composer visible.

xj forwards options to clientThreadId-keyed kj. kj derives W/K from route/pending state; passes a nonnull resume argument only when shouldResume, shared-background permission and host conditions allow. It consumes named cb resume state. Writer conflict makes content read-only, suppresses normal composer and supplies wj retry/fork footer; unavailable shows jj Retry. This is a UI consumer contract, not proof of cb transport or selected manager identity.

kj keeps initial missing-content and previously-seen-content disappearance distinct, attempts first-page hydration once per failed host/conversation key, and separately hydrates background threads. Depending on predicates it toasts not found, navigates to remembered parent or home; imported provider values remain unresolved. Resume failure/history loading/read-only/transcript visibility pass into dj rather than becoming a new turn submission.

dj history status ready/cached differs from error and local failed-history marker. Retry with status error reloads window; other warning Retry only clears local marker. Older history delegates loadOlderConversationHistoryPage, then waits lg; caught failure logs, conditionally records local failure and returns stop. Auto/user-scroll pagination is guarded by history-end, error, durable/resuming and visibility conditions. Scroll snapshot writes use named scoped TD, not evidence of disk persistence.

mr overlay composer disables submit when conversation missing, pending client thread, resume failed/unavailable/writer conflict; it presents retry/conflict UI with supplied callbacks. Local transcript branch is suppressed for failure/unavailable. wj fork is offered by eligibility; pending guards repeat calls, AbortController only suppresses navigation after result and aborts on teardown. Its signal is not passed to the fork delegate.
Removed-host unavailable UI navigates to /settings/connections. This is a repair entry, not automatic reconnection or deletion of the conversation.

Hn local archive footer optionally materializes cwd for nondurable host before manager unarchive. Success marks restoration, offers View now and invalidates archive query. Qualified imported error can still mark restored and show open-error; other failures clear restoration and toast. Local delete is offered only for local host, native threadArchive capability and matching selected preview, then requires confirmation. Delete result must include id; account/visit/location guards protect list update/navigation. This reuses existing archive/delete goals with different callbacks, not proven equivalent receiver identities.

Co hotkey path bypasses these Zo archive/overlay restrictions and defaults showComposer:true. Product mode is not inferred from main/hotkey or local/remote.

Co selects focused assistant or current assistant. pending/in_progress sets working; failed shows Open in web banner. Composer requires showComposer and nonnull status. Task loading with no data shows spinner; data renders To while query error independently shows its message. Review apply banner additionally requires diff, task id, focused assistant id and detail-level condition. Header and error CTA use imported open-browser bridge with /tasks/id.

Co unread effect stores existing read timestamp or truncated creation-time milliseconds, then delegates mark-read mutation. It is an automatic mechanism rather than a separate user click. The named wo called by a diff effect is literally empty in this frozen program and declares no side effects; no diff notification is established.

To groups turns using imported grouping/focus helpers; empty groupings show loading. Nonempty groups render attachments, annotations, user text/comments and selected assistant. Only focused assistant receives fallbackDiff when code is not hidden. Search orchestration is remote:taskId keyed; bookmark attachment is absent while turnsLoading. Scrolling waits Wr and checks optional abort signal before DOM scroll; imported rendering/search authorities remain boundaries.

Cloud footer z awaits POST /wham/tasks/{task_id}/recover then updates selected archive state. Success supplies restored callback and View now, which clears selected preview and replaces location state:null. Failure clears restoration and toasts. Restoring/restored also derive from saved archive operation state. The generic noncloud branch uses another adapter; no server or disk result was observed.

ra and header da both consume local Program-bound Qi, not an imported Qi. Qi creates named Ct apply-patch mutation; if not pending and resolved root is truthy, it sends diff/cwd/operationSource:remote_conversation_apply_diff/revert. Apply/reapply use false, revert true. On returned status success it toggles named per-turn applied state; non-success result opens details; mutation rejection reports an error. ra/da disable actions when applying or !canApply. Root resolution, mutation receiver and real filesystem effects remain separate boundaries; no patch success or mode exclusion was observed.

proposalIdDispositions.rationale: 计划任务列表操作的是 automation，而非归档记录、进程任务管理器或聊天索引。
创建持久计划任务，区别于会话首条消息和普通任务草稿；临时 heartbeat 会话是分步副作用。
编辑 automation 配置、schedule 与保存状态，不能与环境配置编辑合并。
暂停/恢复计划任务，资源和接口不同于录制或导入同步。
删除计划任务而非云环境或归档线程；保留 success:false 与非事务清理边界。
立即请求执行已有计划任务，区别于直接提交用户消息；受理不代表任务执行完成。
查看所选计划任务配置与运行历史；打开关联会话是其上下文操作。
为执行历史设置已读状态；列表读取、自动展开及批量操作归于同一目标。
OAuth 返回草稿恢复没有独立用户提交入口；作为创建/编辑的身份与有效期支撑，不新增用户功能。
只重新打开本地任务同步选择，不等于其他产品的自动导入同步，也不等于完成迁移。
对话预填是创建计划任务的另一入口；并入创建目标，保留尚未创建任务的阶段边界。
复用本地线程归档目标，新增历史单项/批量/恢复操作；不与账户批量归档或旧undo宣称实现等价。
